TOKEN_EQ.definition: for tokens s, t of T: a decidable judgement s = t
TOKEN_EQ.price_vs_A1: outside A1's bill: A1 admits no identity relation of the object language, and TOKEN_EQ is one, on the token sort
TOKEN_EQ.price_vs_A3: not contained in A3's bill, which it does not contain either: A3 imports the metatheory's identity on the CARRIER through function types, composition, and the one-point carrier; TOKEN_EQ is an identity on T only, says nothing about carrier points, and uses no function type, no composition, and no one-point carrier; the two bills are incomparable under inclusion of their listed items, and no ranking between them is claimed (no order on metatheory bills is declared in this tree)

TOKEN_NAMES.definition: one object-language constant for each element of T
TOKEN_NAMES.price: beyond TOKEN_EQ: a question may address a token by its metatheoretic name; the answers are then not invariant under token bijections (computed per enumerated space: the receipt key cells.<cell>.spaces.<space>.invariant_under_token_bijections.V2_NAMED is false in every enumerated space)
